title: A novel mathematical framework to predict in vivo bispecific GTX-B001 binding in skin, and translation to humans
summary: See how quantitative pharmacology and PBPK modeling supported first in human dose selection for a novel bispecific antibody.

### Advance Your First in Human Dose Selection Strategy


Learn how Certara’s quantitative pharmacology, pharmacometrics, physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK), and quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) experts help sponsors optimize candidate selection, support first in human dose selection, and reduce development risk through model informed drug development.
